description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe dressed in white, sitting on the window sill of her Abiquiu studio surrounded by painting supplies, paint brushes, a  rock and antlers.  She wears  a lightweight white collared long sleeved short jacket over a white collared shirt with a round silver dome (hand hammered) button or pin at the neck and a broomstick-type skirt with hands clasped over her lap.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
